component.name: Bintana Project
component.summary: Open, edit and write back MS Project (MSPDI) files

description.p: Bintana Project opens an MS Project XML file, edits its tasks in a tree beside a Gantt chart, and writes it back without touching what the model does not own.
It is a scheduler one phase at a time: task sheets, calendars, resources and their rates.

component.summary: Abrí, editá y reescribí archivos de MS Project (MSPDI)
component.description: Bintana Project abre un archivo XML de MS Project, edita sus tareas en un árbol junto a un Gantt y lo vuelve a escribir sin tocar lo que el modelo no posee.
